summary: Small business car park among shops; packed with work vans, little spare room.
reasons: Nearest home 28 m away, across the road
Lot looks full of business vehicles
Street signs show loading zones, not parking

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by commercial buildings and car parks; nearest dwelling is 28 m away across Woodville Street. Business owners next door would notice.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lot with an opening to the street; the imagery shows it nearly full of vans and utes, so a free bay is uncertain.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street with light traffic; the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Looks like a trade or business yard rather than public parking; no sign of campers.

flags: Business use: the lot may be private or reserved for staff
Street signs: loading zone and school-day no stopping on Woodville Street
Gate mapped 94 m away on a way with a route round it; does not affect access
sun_shade: Open sealed surface; a building to the south casts shade over the south edge in the morning and midday.
cannot_judge: Whether the lot is private or signed on site

best_section.where: West end of the small lot behind the street frontage, beside the large commercial building
